Salon.title: Salon
Salon.description: Represents a salon tenant in the multi-tenant application.

salonId.description: Unique identifier for the salon entity.

address.description: The street address of the salon.

city.description: The city where the salon is located.

state.description: The state where the salon is located.

phone.description: The phone number of the salon.

gstNumber.description: The GST number of the salon (optional).

languageDefault.description: The default language of the salon (e.g., en, hi, ta, ml, te).

timezone.description: The timezone of the salon (e.g., IST).

billingStatus.description: The billing status of the salon.

trialEndsAt.description: The timestamp when the trial period ends.

businessHours.description: The business hours of the salon (e.g., JSON string).

appointmentsEnabled.description: Indicates whether the appointments feature is enabled for the salon.

themeColor.description: The HSL value for the primary theme color of the salon.

loyaltyPointsRatio.description: The percentage of the final bill amount that is awarded as loyalty points.

loyaltyProgramEnabled.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program is enabled for the salon.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user associated with a specific salon.

userId.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

role.description: The role of the user (e.g., owner, receptionist, staff).

phone.description: The phone number of the user (for OTP login).

Service.title: Service
Service.description: Represents a service offered by a salon.

serviceId.description: Unique identifier for the service entity.

Staff.title: Staff
Staff.description: Represents a staff member working at a salon.

staffId.description: Unique identifier for the staff entity.

name.description: The name of the staff member.

aadharNumber.description: The staff member's Aadhar card number.

dob.description: The staff member's date of birth.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Represents a customer of a salon.

customerId.description: Unique identifier for the customer entity.

phone.description: The phone number of the customer.

visitHistory.description: A record of the customer's visit history.

loyaltyPoints.description: The number of loyalty points the customer has accumulated.

SubscriptionPlan.title: SubscriptionPlan
SubscriptionPlan.description: Represents a subscription plan for the SaaS application.

subscriptionPlanId.description: Unique identifier for the subscription plan entity.

name.description: The name of the subscription plan (e.g., Starter, Professional).

monthlyPrice.description: The monthly price of the subscription plan.

yearlyPrice.description: The yearly price of the subscription plan.

staffLimit.description: The maximum number of staff allowed on the plan.

whatsappReminders.description: Indicates whether WhatsApp reminders are included in the plan.

gstInvoices.description: Indicates whether GST invoices are included in the plan.

onlineBookingLink.description: Indicates whether an online booking link is included in the plan.

advancedReports.description: Indicates whether advanced reports are included in the plan.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Represents a customer review for a staff member after an appointment.

staffId.description: Reference to the Staff member being reviewed.

customerId.description: Reference to the Customer who gave the review.

appointmentId.description: Reference to the Appointment this review is for.

rating.description: The star rating given, from 1 to 5.

comment.description: Optional text comment from the customer.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the review was submitted.

firestore.reasoning:
This Firestore structure is designed for a multi-tenant Salon Management SaaS application. The top-level collection, `salons`, represents individual salons. Each salon's data is then stored in subcollections under its respective document. This approach ensures data isolation and scalability for multiple salons within the same application instance.

Key features of this structure:

1.  **Multi-Tenancy:** The `salons` collection serves as the root for tenant isolation. Each salon has its own set of subcollections, preventing data mixing.
2.  **Authorization Independence:** The `salonId` is present in every document within a salon's subcollections (e.g., `/salons/{salonId}/users/{userId}`). This denormalization allows security rules to validate that a user or resource belongs to the correct salon without needing to perform costly `get()` operations to retrieve parent data. The rule can simply check `request.resource.data.salonId == resource.data.salonId`.
3.  **QAPs (Rules are not Filters):** The structure facilitates secure `list` operations. For example, listing all `users` associated with a particular `salonId` can be secured by ensuring the `salonId` in the requested documents matches the `salonId` of the user making the request.
4. **Ownership:** Using hierarchical paths such as `/salons/{salonId}/users/{userId}` establishes a clear ownership model where each document inherently belongs to a specific salon. This simplifies security rules based on ownership.

This structure also supports easy querying within a specific salon's data. For example, fetching all appointments for a specific staff member in a salon is straightforward using collection group queries (once enabled).

This design avoids hierarchical authorization dependencies to support atomic operations and simplifies debugging. All rules can rely solely on `request.auth.uid` and the `salonId` denormalized into each document for authorization.
